params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $dest=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-quota-circuit-verify2'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $dest){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dest -Recurse -Force}; git clone --depth 1 --branch fix/codex-quota-dispatch-circuit-20260929 https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $dest; $clone=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('CLONE_EXIT='+$clone); if($clone -ne 0){exit $clone}; $ac=Join-Path $dest 'tools\agent-control'; Push-Location $ac; try { cmd.exe /d /s /c "npm run check"; $check=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('CHECK_EXIT='+$check); cmd.exe /d /s /c "npm test"; $test=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('TEST_EXIT='+$test) } finally { Pop-Location }; git -C $dest diff --check; $diff=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('DIFF_CHECK_EXIT='+$diff); if(($check -ne 0) -or ($test -ne 0) -or ($diff -ne 0)){exit 1}; Write-Output 'QUOTA_CIRCUIT_TEST_PASS'
